fun_facts: In middle school, Charlie Becker’s father coached him and had him play with older kids; he recognized that Charlie was a natural receiver.
At Father Ryan, Becker was fast: his coach said he usually ran the 40-yard dash in 4.4 seconds and sometimes clocked below 4.3.
Against Howard in 2026, Becker caught three touchdown passes on just three receptions.
A touchdown against Washington in 2026 pushed Becker past 1,000 receiving yards for the season. He became the eighth Hoosier to reach that mark, and the first since 2019.
In 2025, 85.3% of Becker’s catches went for a first down or touchdown—the best rate among Power 4 receivers, according to ESPN Research.
